Command: Leave gleanings of your harvest for the poor
Summary: The gleanings of the harvest are left for the poor, who may gather them from the field.
Commandment: Leave gleanings of your harvest for the poor.
Application: The positive form of the harvest gleaning law: what falls in the reaping belongs, by law, to the poor who follow the reapers. Ruth's gleaning in Boaz's field is the living picture of this law at work.
Purpose: God's stated care for those without a defender — widow, orphan, stranger — carried by James into the church as pure religion (James 1:27). In the harvest, that care takes the form of leaving the gleanings for the poor.
